<description>
Part of #36692.

Add `MakeTx()` and use it in `TestPackageSelection` and `TestPrioritisedMining` so each transaction is fully specified where it is created, instead of overwriting the `prevout` and `nValue` of the previous one. Also build the `CreateBigSigOpsTx()` and `CreateBigSigOpsCluster()` transactions in place.

One implicit dependency is now explicit: BulkTransaction() pads the output script of hashFreeTx2, and the next two transactions inherited it. Their size matters for the fee rate checks, so the padded script is now passed to `MakeTx()` explicitly.

The txid, wtxid and fee of every transaction added to the mempool are unchanged.
</description>

<commits>
a0e8878eb2 test: construct miner_tests package selection transactions declaratively

Add MakeTx() and use it in TestPackageSelection and TestPrioritisedMining
to construct each transaction from its prevout and output value, instead
of overwriting fields of the previous transaction.

546d828c93 test: construct miner_tests sigops transactions declaratively

Construct the inputs and outputs of CreateBigSigOpsTx() and the parent
transaction of CreateBigSigOpsCluster() in place instead of resizing the
vectors and assigning each field afterwards.
</commits>
